## Key Discovery: Weak Key Scanner

**All 100,543 private keys in the DB started with `0x000000000000000000...`** — sequential keys generated by counting up from zero. This is mathematically hopeless (2^256 key space).

```sql
-- Confirm approach failure
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wallets WHERE balance_usd > 0;  -- 0
SELECT wallet_address, substr(private_key,1,24) FROM keys LIMIT 5;
-- 0xf6d884... key=0x000000000000000000...
-- 0x4845ec... key=0x000000000000000000...
```
